newsitem.title: PERU: Minero Peru invites firms to study Las Bambas.
newsitem.headline: Minero Peru invites firms to study Las Bambas.

text.p: Peruvian state miner Minero Peru said companies interested in studying its Las Bambas copper deposit prior to privatization next year have until Oct 30 to register their interest.
"Companies who express an interest after this date will not be authorized to carry out drillings at the site," Minero Peru said in a statement.
Minero Peru plans to auction the Las Bambas deposit in the second quarter of 1997, provided the firm can clear up a legal problem involving a third party making claims on the property.

Las Bambas only has so far proven reserves of 17 million tonnes and probable reserves of 27 million tonnes, but it has a rich content of copper, between 1.8 percent and 2.2 percent, according to Minero Peru.
Minero Peru President Jorge Kawamura said recently that between 700 and 800 million tonnes of reserves would need to be found to make Las Bambas viable to mine.
